messages:
Alex Chen: Draft OKRs for next quarter posted below — need quick alignment and sign-off by EOD Wed.

Alex Chen: Objectives:
- Objective A: Improve inference P95 latency by 20% for hosted API (baseline: 1100ms)
- Objective B: Reduce per-token cost by 15% via batching + quantization profiles
- Objective C: Enterprise: onboard 3 Dedicated contracts with SLA commitments

Mira Patel: overlapping Qs — for Objective A, is 20% measured across all models or top 3? I suggest top-3 traffic models to be realistic.

Sam Rivera: Agreed with Mira. Also, need to add rollout criteria: canary: <5% traffic, monitor quality evals for regression >2%.

Jordan Lee: Curious on tradeoffs — chasing 20% P95 with more batching may harm tail latency for small requests. Can we define SLOs per route?

Alex Chen: Good point. Proposal: two buckets — interactive routes (SLO P95 <= 1500ms) and batch routes (throughput objective). I can add to draft.

Katie O'Neal: For Objective B, customer ask (FinReg client) requires int8 quantization not to exceed 1% quality drop. We should make that an explicit guardrail.

Mira Patel: Also, launch criteria for Dedicated onboarding: network audit complete, KMS integration validated, and e2e perf tests pass at 80% of committed throughput.

Sam Rivera: Sales flagged one large potential deal requiring a private VPC within 6 weeks — if we deprioritize Dedicated, risk losing them.

Alex Chen: Tradeoff decision needed: prioritize Dedicated (enterprise revenue risk) or invest more in hosted perf (broader cost wins). Recommend prioritizing Dedicated for Q target with a parallel small perf task force.

Jordan Lee: Can we commit 1 eng lead + 2 SREs for Dedicated for 6 weeks, and 2 perf engineers for optimizations? That's my vote.

Katie O'Neal: +1. Action items:
- Alex: update draft with gating criteria and two-bucket SLOs (by Tue noon)
- Jordan: resource plan for Dedicated (by Tue EOD)
- Mira: add quantization guardrail and eval spec (by Wed)

Alex Chen: ok will update. If no major objections, I'll mark as signed-off and move to exec sync on Thu.

pm-bot: Reminder — sign-off deadline set to 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.

Sam Rivera: Approve in principle — pending resource confirmation.

Mira Patel: Approve conditional on top-3 model scope for Objective A.

Jordan Lee: Approve conditional on resource commit.

Katie O'Neal: Approve.
